# Skills.sh

> > A comprehensive catalog of agent skills and templates for GitHub Copilot, AI agents, and development automation, featuring standardized skill documentation and prompt engineering best practices.

Skills.sh hosts structured skill definitions for AI agents, GitHub Copilot workflows, and development automation tools. The platform emphasizes skill standardization through the Agent Skills Specification, enabling developers to create, share, and discover reusable skills across various domains including cloud infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and prompt engineering.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- Agent Skills Specification
- Skill Standardization
- Prompt Engineering
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- GitHub Actions & Automation
- Azure Cloud Services
- Skill Documentation & Validation
- AI-Powered Development
- Node.js & JavaScript
- Infrastructure as Code
- Multi-Agent Systems
- Progressive Disclosure
- SKILL.md Format
- Development Workflows

## Skill Standardization & Core Specifications

- [skill-standardization by supercent-io/skills-template](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/skill-standardization): Agent Skills Specification standard with SKILL.md validation & metadata

## GitHub Copilot & AI Agent Development

- [microsoft-foundry by microsoft/github-copilot-for-azure](https://skills.sh/microsoft/github-copilot-for-azure/microsoft-foundry): Microsoft Foundry AI agent development, deployment & evaluation guide
- [prompt-builder by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/prompt-builder): GitHub Copilot prompt engineering with .prompt.md templates for VS Code
- [prompt-repetition by supercent-io/skills-template](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/prompt-repetition): LLM prompt optimization for Gemini 2.0 & GPT-4o with benchmarks
- [copilot-usage-metrics by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/copilot-usage-metrics): GitHub Copilot usage analytics & enterprise metrics via CLI tool
- [polyglot-test-agent by github/awesome-copilot](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/polyglot-test-agent): AI-powered polyglot test generation with multi-agent pipeline

## Development Automation & CI/CD
